title: U-Shape IV Intraday
notes: Requires intraday IV data at 1-min resolution. Intraday chain endpoint is PROVISIONAL — may return INSUFFICIENT_DATA if subscription tier does not include intraday access. Contract selection: nearest ATM 0-1 DTE call per day. Session buckets: open (9:30-10:00), mid (11:30-14:00), close (15:30-16:00). U-shape confirmed if open_iv > mid_iv AND close_iv > mid_iv, both statistically significant (p < 0.05, paired t-test across days). Proxy fallback: EOD IVX level only — very degraded test, labeled proxy_tested.
